curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the steady red light, right and left turns on red, the red arrow and the flashing red light, comparing each pair.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per red signal rule, with contrast cards for steady versus flashing red and right versus left on red.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a red signal and asking whether you may turn or go.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the steady and flashing yellow light or arrow, finishing a turn when the light changes, the green light's yielding duties and the protected green arrow.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule, with contrast cards for steady versus flashing yellow and green light versus green arrow.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on what a driver may do at a yellow or green signal.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the Walk, flashing Don't Walk and steady Don't Walk signals and what pedestrians should do at each.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per signal phase, with a contrast card for flashing versus steady Don't Walk.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on what a pedestrian should do at each signal.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover how lane use control signals work, the green arrow, yellow X and arrows, red X, and how freeway ramp meters release one car per green.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each lane signal, with contrast cards for steady yellow X versus yellow arrow and flashing X versus flashing arrow.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming an overhead lane signal and asking what it allows.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain white lines for same-direction traffic, dashed, short thick, solid and double white lines, bicycle lanes, then yellow lines for opposite traffic, passing rules and the road layouts.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per marking, with contrast cards for should versus must not change lanes and single versus double yellow.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a line pattern and asking whether you may change lanes or pass.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover white turn arrows, solid lines at turn lanes, center left-turn lanes, reversible lanes, carpool lanes and painted warning messages.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each lane type, with a contrast card for center turn lanes versus reversible lanes.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a special lane and asking who may use it.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain that officers' hand signals come before signals and markings, and how officers signal stop and go with hands and whistles.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per officer rule, with a contrast card for the long versus short whistle blasts.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing an officer's signal and asking what to do.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec10-m01..sec10-m07; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
